response.justification: The candidate comfortably exceeds every technical requirement — strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, REST, Kubernetes, AWS, and even LLM/MCP tooling experience — but with nearly 20 years of experience and current Staff Engineer status, he is significantly overqualified for an entry-level role. This raises real concerns about salary expectations, retention, and role fit, though if he has genuine reasons for wanting this position, he could deliver immediate value.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js and fullstack experience directly matching the core stack
Nice-to-have coverage: LLM/AI-agent tooling (MCP), Kubernetes, AWS, DevOps
Proven mentorship, testing culture (TDD), and clean-architecture mindset
concerns: Heavily overqualified for a junior/mid entry-level position (Staff/Senior for ~10 years)
Likely salary and seniority expectations mismatch; retention/flight risk
PostgreSQL not explicitly listed (MongoDB/MySQL instead) and no direct energy/construction domain exposure

key_factors.factor: Excellent technical stack alignment (TypeScript, React, Node, K8s, LLMs)
